title: This Food Truck Makes More in 10 Days Than Most Make All Year

idea.name: The Bell Sweet Factory food truck
idea.one_liner: A family operated food truck sells New Orleans style meals, desserts and drinks to local customers through a fixed site and occasional pop-ups, earning per-order sales.
idea.customer: Consumers near the truck's fixed location and pop-ups.
idea.offer: Prepared New Orleans style meals, desserts and drinks for pickup.
idea.revenue_model: Direct sales of plates, sides, desserts and drinks.

tools: Custom QR check-in and SMS waitlist system

ideas.other_uk_rules: A UK operator would need to register the food business with the local authority and meet food hygiene and allergen information requirements. Collecting customer phone numbers and sending service updates engages UK GDPR and PECR; marketing texts need the required consent.

idea.name: QR waitlist and order-ready SMS system
idea.one_liner: A custom queue tool for food trucks and similar operators checks customers in by QR code and texts them when it is their turn or order is ready, charging a monthly fee.
idea.customer: Food trucks and other small food operators managing customer queues.
idea.offer: QR-based check-in, queue status and order-ready text notifications.
idea.revenue_model: Monthly subscription, with a custom-built setup and ongoing backend support described.

key_quotes.quote: So actually a customer built this for us because our lives used to be wrapped around a corner.
And you can text them when they order ready.
When we started out, it was $35. Now since we've been here, and he kind of upgraded everything, it's $50 a month, but it's very much well-workedy.

claims.claim: The service initially cost $35.
claims.quote: When we started out, it was $35. Now since we've been here, and he kind of upgraded everything, it's $50 a month, but it's very much well-workedy.

claims.claim: The upgraded service costs $50 per month.
claims.quote: When we started out, it was $35. Now since we've been here, and he kind of upgraded everything, it's $50 a month, but it's very much well-workedy.

ideas.delivery: A developer built and maintains the system for the food truck, including backend work. Customers scan a QR code, enter their name and number, and receive queue and order status texts.
ideas.other_uk_rules: The service processes names and phone numbers, so UK GDPR applies. Order status texts should remain transactional service messages; PECR requirements apply if the numbers are used for marketing.

idea.name: The Bell Sweet Factory brick-and-mortar restaurant
idea.one_liner: The couple opened a restaurant after operating a food truck, but struggled with restaurant management and exited the lease to return to the truck.
idea.offer: Restaurant meals, with the menu not fully specified separately from the truck.
idea.revenue_model: Restaurant food sales; revenue and pricing for the restaurant are not stated.

key_quotes.quote: Once we went inside the restaurant, we kind of realized we didn't know what we was doing.
Cooking food and running the restaurant is totally different.
